title: Replace the Core-to-MCP internals grant with a narrow writer-lease probe facade
outcome: The MCP daemon can probe writer-lease availability without gaining access to every CodeNav.Core internal.
acceptance: CodeNav.Core exposes a narrow writer-lease probe contract sufficient for daemon retirement
DaemonRetirement no longer names IndexLeaseAcquireResult in its test seam

Decide and document the Core/MCP boundary for SemanticService.EmitTerminalTelemetry, SemanticColdStartTimingBox.Publish and ProjectFileParser.SimpleFSharpProjectModelReason before removing the Core-to-MCP internals grant
